title: Unit – 1 : Session – 3 | Self-Exploration
sections: Q1. Self-exploration is 'the dialogue within' — a dialogue between WHAT I AM (my present state, natural acceptance, desires as they are) and WHAT I REALLY WANT TO BE (my natural acceptance / innate expectation of happiness). When the two are in HARMONY, I am at peace — this state itself is happiness. When they are in CONTRADICTION, I feel tension, frustration, guilt — this is unhappiness. Self-exploration continuously compares the two and moves 'what I am' towards 'what I want to be'.

Q2. Natural acceptance is the innate, unconditional acceptance in the Self for what is right — e.g., the natural acceptance for relationship, trust and respect. Characteristics: (a) it does not change with TIME — constant; (b) it does not change with PLACE — universal; (c) it does not change with the INDIVIDUAL — same for all; (d) it is UNCONDITIONAL — not dependent on circumstances; (e) it can be verified by EVERYONE in their own right — self-evident.

Q3. CONTENT of self-exploration: (1) Desire — what is my basic aspiration? (continuous happiness and prosperity). (2) Program — what is the way to fulfil it? (right understanding + right feeling + physical facility). PROCESS of self-exploration: (1) It is a process of SEEING within oneself, not of preaching or sermonising. (2) Whatever is stated is put forward as a PROPOSAL — do not accept it blindly, nor reject it. (3) VERIFY it on your own right — check it against your natural acceptance. (4) LIVE accordingly — observe it in behaviour and work, and validate it in experience.
